tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Thank you for speaking with me today. First, is mobile phone important to people? Tell me about important things people can do with their mobile phones.
tasks.analysis: 中文：感谢您今天与我交谈。首先，手机对人们重要吗？请告诉我人们可以用手机做哪些重要的事情。
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: I see. Here's another question about reading methods. Many people today read books on tablets or phones. Others prefer to read books on paper. Which do you prefer and why?
tasks.analysis: 中文：我明白了。这里还有一个关于阅读方式的问题。现在很多人通过平板电脑或手机阅读书籍，另一些人则更喜欢阅读纸质书。您更喜欢哪种方式？为什么？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Interesting. Now think about a piece of technology that you don't have and that you really want to get. Please describe it to me and why do you want it?
tasks.analysis: 中文：有意思。现在请思考一件您目前没有但非常想拥有的科技产品。请向我描述它，并说明为什么想要？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Good points. Now, a final question. Some parents think that children spend too much time using technology instead of playing outside. Do you agree with the idea that children should spend less time using technology? Why, oh, why not?
tasks.analysis: 中文：说得好。现在是最后一个问题。有些家长认为孩子花太多时间使用科技产品，而不是去户外玩耍。您是否认为孩子应该减少使用科技产品的时间？为什么赞成或为什么不赞成？
tasks.title: Interview
